title_cyr: Море три години Стамбол го шетав
title_latin: More tri godini Stambol go šetav
title_en: For Three Years I Roamed Istanbul
background: A pechalba song with a sad twist. Three years working in Istanbul and three thousand groats saved. The first thousand bought a horse, the second went on the horse, the third was meant to marry Temjano; just as he sets out for home, the horse dies in the middle of the stream. Istanbul (*Stambol*) was the economic magnet before America was.
background_source: Source of these notes: Qwen's draft.
en_note: Machine translation by Claude (my reading), not on Pesna.org and not checked by a native speaker. Treat it as a study aid.
translator_notes: Temjano is a woman's name used as an address. 'такам за коњче' and 'коњче ми пукна' (literally 'burst', my reading: the horse gave out or died) are my reading.

lines.cyr: Ајде три години Стамбол го шетав, Темјано.
lines.lat: Ajde tri godini Stambol go šetav, Temjano.
lines.en: Come on, three years I roamed Istanbul, Temjano.

lines.cyr: Море си спечалив до три илјади,
lines.lat: More si spečaliv do tri iljadi,
lines.en: Hey, I earned up to three thousand,

lines.cyr: Првата илјада коњче си купив, Темјано.
lines.lat: Prvata iljada konjče si kupiv, Temjano.
lines.en: The first thousand I bought myself a horse, Temjano.
The second thousand just for the horse,

lines.cyr: Третата илјада тебе да те земам, Темјано.
lines.lat: Tretata iljada tebe da te zemam, Temjano.
lines.en: The third thousand to take you, Temjano.

lines.cyr: Третата илјада тебе да те зема,
lines.lat: Tretata iljada tebe da te zema,
lines.en: The third thousand to take you,

lines.cyr: Таман кинисав дома да си идам, Темјано.
lines.lat: Taman kinisav doma da si idam, Temjano.
lines.en: I had just set off to go home, Temjano.

lines.cyr: На среде поток коњче ми пукна,
lines.lat: Na srede potok konjče mi pukna,
lines.en: In the middle of the stream my horse gave out,
